title: Dal causes no suspicion at all!

nodes.speaker: Dal McGrath
nodes.text: Boss?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Boss?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Dal, I have a question.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Dal, I have a question.

nodes.speaker: Dal McGrath
nodes.text: Yeah?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You said you were unlicensed...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You said you were unlicensed...

nodes.speaker: Dal McGrath
nodes.text: Right boss. No license, no Corp oversight, no extra fees. Sweet deal, as long as none of us "falsely" state I'm a cleaner.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Right boss. No license, no Corp oversight, no extra fees. Sweet deal, as long as none of us "falsely" state I'm a cleaner.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I have been thinking about what "unlicensed" means.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I have been thinking about what "unlicensed" means.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I have been thinking about what "unlicensed" means.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I have been thinking about what "unlicensed" means.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Isn't hiring you to clean... illegal?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Isn't hiring you to clean... illegal?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Isn't hiring you to clean... illegal?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Isn't hiring you to clean... illegal?

nodes.speaker: Dal McGrath
nodes.text: And you decided it's fine. Right?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And you decided it's fine. Right?

nodes.speaker: Dal McGrath
nodes.text: Well, the Corps sure wouldn't be happy... if they knew.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, the Corps sure wouldn't be happy... if they knew.

nodes.speaker: Dal McGrath
nodes.text: And you've got the heart of a real cold-blooded Corpster beating in your chest. I just think there could be more to you, you know? Deep down? But... maybe I'm wrong.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And you've got the heart of a real cold-blooded Corpster beating in your chest. I just think there could be more to you, you know? Deep down? But... maybe I'm wrong.

nodes.speaker: Dal McGrath
nodes.text: Sure, and you pay the higher fees? Come on! We both know what this arrangement really is.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sure, and you pay the higher fees? Come on! We both know what this arrangement really is.

nodes.speaker: Dal McGrath
nodes.text: And it's not just the best financial deal you got, it's the moral one too. You think the Corps need MORE money? Every penny they get lets them launch some new initiative that's worse than the last one.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And it's not just the best financial deal you got, it's the moral one too. You think the Corps need MORE money? Every penny they get lets them launch some new initiative that's worse than the last one.

nodes.speaker: Dal McGrath
nodes.text: Are you kiddin' me? Where to start? Taking healthy blood from babies to keep old trillionaires healthy? The enzymes in the breakfast cereal?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Are you kiddin' me? Where to start? Taking healthy blood from babies to keep old trillionaires healthy? The enzymes in the breakfast cereal?

nodes.speaker: Dal McGrath
nodes.text: And don't forget Kumitara, the last panda. They put her on a satellite and used her to sell diet pills.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And don't forget Kumitara, the last panda. They put her on a satellite and used her to sell diet pills.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I think you're making some of these up Dal.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I think you're making some of these up Dal.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I think you're making some of these up Dal.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I think you're making some of these up Dal.

nodes.speaker: Dal McGrath
nodes.text: You know what the Corps are capable of. You gotta choose, are you one of 'em?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You know what the Corps are capable of. You gotta choose, are you one of 'em?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Those pills didn't work.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Those pills didn't work.

nodes.speaker: Dal McGrath
nodes.text: Look, I know you need to play the game and all that, but I been watching you closely. Watching how you treat folk. I know how you really feel about all this shit. I know the kinda person you are.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Look, I know you need to play the game and all that, but I been watching you closely. Watching how you treat folk. I know how you really feel about all this shit. I know the kinda person you are.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Thanks Dal.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Thanks Dal.

nodes.speaker: Dal McGrath
nodes.text: You're a good un'. Sure, you can be hard when you need to be, but deep down your decent. You're not just a cog in the Corp machine. You really care about people.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're a good un'. Sure, you can be hard when you need to be, but deep down your decent. You're not just a cog in the Corp machine. You really care about people.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Like what?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Like what?

nodes.speaker: Dal McGrath
nodes.text: Nah, don't thank me boss. I should be thanking YOU. A good boss in Nivalis... that's a rare thing. I mean it. You're on the right track. Thank you boss.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Nah, don't thank me boss. I should be thanking YOU. A good boss in Nivalis... that's a rare thing. I mean it. You're on the right track. Thank you boss.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Life is more complicated than you make it sound Dal.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Life is more complicated than you make it sound Dal.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Life is more complicated than you make it sound Dal.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Life is more complicated than you make it sound Dal.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You are wrong. There's more to me than business.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You are wrong. There's more to me than business.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You are wrong. There's more to me than business.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You are wrong. There's more to me than business.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Maybe I can be a little less... Corp in the future.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Maybe I can be a little less... Corp in the future.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Maybe I can be a little less... Corp in the future.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Maybe I can be a little less... Corp in the future.

nodes.speaker: Dal McGrath
nodes.text: Yeah, maybe. It's never too late to start being a good person boss. Anyway... I better get back to work before you fire me...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah, maybe. It's never too late to start being a good person boss. Anyway... I better get back to work before you fire me...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why don't you just get a license?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why don't you just get a license?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Why don't you just get a license?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Why don't you just get a license?

nodes.text: Dal causes no suspicion at all!
Dal causes no suspicion at all!
